title: Ngā Kaiwhakataka o te Kawenata i Whakaraua
intro: I ngā rā tōmua o tētahi hapori hou, i noho tētahi iwi i roto i ngā whare pā, i herea e tētahi kawenata. I te wā i tukua ai taua kawenata, ka rangona ngā hua i roto i ngā whārangi o te Quran. Ko wai ēnei tāngata, ā, i pēhea ō rātou kāinga me ō rātou māra hua rākau?
clues: I noho mātou i roto i ngā pā kaha i homai ai ki a mātou te whakaaro teka o te haumaru.
He iwi tātou nō te Karaipiture, heoi kua takahia e tātou tā tātou kawenata.
I whakatakoto mātou i tā mātou whakaaro mō te karere i muri i tōna taenga mai ki a mātou, engari i rahua tā mātou whakaaro.
I tuaina ā mātou nikau e te whakahau a Allah, he tohu mō Tōna mana.
I peia mātou i ō mātou kāinga, kāore rawa i hoki mai, hei whiu mō tō mātou whakakeke.
E whakahuatia ana tātou e te Quran i roto i te upoko o te huihuinga, ā, he whakatūpato tā tātou kōrero mō te hunga e takahi ana i ngā kawenata.

trial.answer: Te whakapaenga me te peinga i ō rātou kāinga

outcome.answer: I peia atu, ā, i tangohia ō rātou taonga

arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
